prompt: Which IIT (Indian Institute of Technology) in India installed the first supercomputer under the National Supercomputing Mission (NSM)?
answer: The **Indian Institute of Technology (BHU), Varanasi (IIT-BHU)** installed the first supercomputer under the National Supercomputing Mission—**PARAM Shivay**, inaugurated in 2019.
